registros.titulo: Chelsea vs Leeds Prediction: Premier League Preview
registros.resumen: The Opta supercomputer ranks Chelsea as the favourites in Saturday afternoon's clash, with a win probability of 51.1% to Leeds United's 24.0%. Three of Chelsea's four defeats this season have come to nil.

metricas.racha_local: Chelsea have taken 10 points from five home Premier League games this season (W3 D1 L1), their best tally in that span.
metricas.racha_visitante: Leeds have generated the most xG from set-pieces (excluding penalties) in the Premier League this season (6.1).
metricas.h2h_resumen: Dos últimos encuentros de la temporada pasada: 3-1 en Elland Road y 2-2 en Stamford Bridge.

insight.resumen: Chelsea 51.1% / empate 24.8% / Leeds 24.0% según 10.000 simulaciones del Opta supercomputer.

registros.notas: Probabilidades literales del artículo. Forma local W3 D1 L1 de cinco partidos en casa. xG de tiros libres de Leeds NO es xG del partido, por eso es null.

registros.titulo: Man City vs Napoli Prediction: UEFA Champions League Preview
registros.resumen: Manchester City are the heavy favourites for this encounter, having come out on top in 71.2% of pre-match simulations by the Opta supercomputer. The same data-led sims only afforded Napoli a 12.6% chance of victory, with the draw making up the rest of the scenarios at 16.2%.

metricas.racha_local: City are unbeaten at home to Napoli (W2 D1).
metricas.h2h_resumen: City went winless across their first two meetings with Napoli in 2011-12 (D1 L1) and are unbeaten at home to Napoli (W2 D1).

insight.resumen: Manchester City 71.2% / empate 16.2% / Napoli 12.6% según simulaciones previas del Opta supercomputer.

registros.notas: fecha_partido se deja null porque el artículo no exponía la fecha exacta del encuentro.

registros.titulo: Newcastle vs Arsenal Prediction: Premier League Preview
registros.resumen: A sixth straight victory could be on the horizon for Arsenal, with the Opta supercomputer calculating that they have a 56.4% win probability. Newcastle have just a 21.7% chance of springing an upset; a draw has a fractionally higher probability at 21.9%.

metricas.racha_local: The Magpies sit 12th in the table but have won just two of their past eight top-flight outings.
metricas.racha_visitante: Arsenal are chasing a sixth straight Premier League victory.
metricas.h2h_resumen: Arsenal have taken all three points from their past three meetings with Newcastle, with 38 Premier League wins overall against the Magpies.

insight.resumen: Newcastle 21.7% / empate 21.9% / Arsenal 56.4% según 10.000 simulaciones previas del Opta supercomputer.

registros.notas: Artículo textual publicado el mismo sábado del partido.
